---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for RangeForge
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when testing network IDS sensors because...").

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen:
- New emulation protocol (e.g. DNS tunneling simulation, LDAP queries, SSH sessions)
- New persona profile or behavioral model
- Dashboard / Web UI enhancement
- Controller CLI capability

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Target Operating Systems / Topologies**
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Linux
- [ ] FreeBSD / pfSense
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Multi-subnet / Air-gapped Ranges

**Additional context**
Add any other context, cyber range scenarios, RFC references, or screenshots about the feature request here.
